name: Budapesti Ingatlan Hasznositasi es Fejlesztesi Nyrt.
summary: Budapesti Ingatlan Hasznosítási és Fejlesztési Nyrt. engages in the property development business. The company engages in the construction of offices and residential apartment buildings; division of land into lots; and rental, operation, and distribution of properties. It also operates a parking garage. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Budapest, Hungary. Budapesti Ingatlan Hasznosítási és Fejlesztési Nyrt. operates as a subsidiary of PIÓ 21 Kft.
